_comment: FUNCTION: the Serve option pays gold, so it is gated once_per_waking on its own verb:entity key (the Erin's-meal/Relc's-wager seam) -- first use this waking is unlocked, then the option drops OUT of the visible list until the next sleep (_meets_progress hides on the same leg it locks on; no separate hide_when needed). CONSTRAINT: requires-only, single-key -- every patron visit is stage-eligible, so there is no accomplishment leg to compound with. TRAP: without this gate the serve repeats within one waking, +2 gold per pick, unbounded. NOTE: the serve still banks on selection rather than requiring a fetched bowl in hand -- dialogue.gd's _meets() has no item-possession gate type (skill/class/gold/accomplishment/board_accepted/delivery_accepted/once_per_waking only); a real-fetch requirement needs that new gate type in src/core/dialogue.gd first.

greet.speaker: Hungry Patron
greet.text: There you are! Stew, bread, anything - I've been sitting here an age.

options.text: Bring her a bowl from the kitchen. (Serve)

served.speaker: Hungry Patron
served.text: Ahh. Now THAT'S service. I'll want another before long, mind.
